note: flags from an independent visual reviewer who looked at the compare images

flags.problem: At 1:1 the planks show greenish and mauve chroma speckle and blotchy colour noise that the tan original does not have. Plank bands are right, but the colour drifts.
flags.fix: Inject detail into luminance only (Lab L channel) or reduce the a/b chroma of the injected detail, then re-run the colour match so the mean stays near the original tan.

flags.problem: Dark fringe along the diagonal cutout edges and stair-stepped alpha. The planks at 1:1 are also soft, with little grain.
flags.fix: Decontaminate edge colours (replace fringe pixels with the nearest interior colour) and feather the alpha only by about 1px. Use a sharper upscale for the plank grain.

flags.problem: Dark speckled fringe on the cutout edges of the diagonal braces at 1:1, not present in the original.
flags.fix: Erode the alpha mask by about 1px or decontaminate the edge colours before saving, so no dark halo remains on the cut edges.
